source: registry.npmjs.org search (queries: mcp server, keywords:mcp, mcp-server, model context protocol server, keywords:mcp-server, keywords:modelcontextprotocol), candidates as reported by scripts/npm_search.py, filtered to packages with a bin that describe themselves as MCP servers, ranked by weekly downloads
rule: Kept: ships a bin and its npm description says it is (or ships) an MCP server. Excluded: templates and hello-world servers, frameworks and SDKs, clients, inspectors and proxies, installers and config tools, agent harnesses, test fixtures, platform-binary duplicates, and packages whose description does not say MCP server (unless the package name does).
